name: 火云
english_description: The in-game title is Fire Cloud Chronicle 2000 (火云录2000) — an ES/Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite sharing the “hy” prefix with hy, hy2000, and hy2002 (the “Ocean”-titled family) in this project, file-by-file comparison of the core master.lpc, securd.lpc, and securityd.lpc confirms it is not the same lineage — the two families merely happen to both be ES2-derived, Jin Yong-themed wuxia MUDs. hy3's master.lpc has an entirely different structure (credited to “change by xhh,” 363 lines, versus the three byte-identical 332-line “for ES II mudlib” versions in the hy family), and its wizard directories under u/ (xingyun, xingyu, hsly) point to an independently maintained codebase.
